newsitem.title: USA: Charleston County, S.C., approves $102 mln budget.
newsitem.headline: Charleston County, S.C., approves $102 mln budget.

text.p: South Carolina's Charleston County has approved a $102 million operating budget that gives property owners a small tax break, the Post and Courier said Wednesday.
The fiscal 1998 budget reduces property taxes by about $12 a year for the owner of a $100,000 home. But it raises the solid waste fee that all homewoners pay by about $10 a year, to $89.
The property tax cut was offset by increased revenue from the one-cent local-option sales tax approved that voters approved in 1990.
